why: ADR 0132 Phase 1c (BT-3871): the class-side `twice:` invokes its block parameter at the method root, so its module advertises the threaded entry `'__t2_class_twice:'` in `tier2_class_methods`. The instance-side `twice:` threads too (its `MethodInfo::threading_params` is [0]) but gets its entry with ADR 0132 Phase 1d, so `tier2_methods` is still empty. Each expected map is `selector => {"entry_fn": name, "positions": [0-based arg positions]}`; `unthreaded_selectors` are instance methods and `unthreaded_class_selectors` class methods that must resolve to no threaded entry on either side.

ADR 0132 Phase 1c (BT-3871): a class method with a threading parameter (an invocation, the callable of a collection HOM, a same-class pass-on, as a conditional's receiver, in a cascade) advertises its entry and positions; `plain:` (no block), `storeAway:` (stores the block, ADR 0132 section 1) and every method whose body holds a block that does `^` (`callThen:firstPositiveIn:`, `guarded:flag:`, `find:`, `nlrForward:`, `nlrFold:with:`: the `^` could answer a stale `Acc`, BT-3871 review; ADR 0132 Phase 3) advertise none.
